I restarted multiple times (anchors 33, 18, 16, 19, 38, 14), and `[33+, 35-]` emerged as the best 2-feature combination at **Sharpe 0.491 (all-years) / 0.554 (recent-weighted)**. I adjusted one trigger mid-search (logged) when I noticed it was firing too eagerly on marginal-but-positive gains, then used a second adjustment to set a realistic, evidence-based stopping bar once the ceiling became clear across 7 independent anchors.

**Candidate submitted:** Rule `[33+, 35-]` (long feature 33, short feature 35, equal-weighted) — comfortably ahead of the baseline model (Sharpe 0.183/0.246, turnover 0.042).
